title: Beat Bloom
tagline: Grow a neon garden by hitting every downbeat.
description: Each accurate beat grows a stem, opens a flower, and adds a new layer to the loop. Miss too many and the garden folds itself closed.
prompt: Build a self-contained browser game called Beat Bloom. Each accurate beat grows a stem, opens a flower, and adds a new layer to the loop. Miss too many and the garden folds itself closed.
